_comment: Satin paint: the low-sheen finish of painted cabinets, trim, walls and furniture, authored white so a Creator tints it to any colour. Opaque, a dielectric film; the substance is the paint, not what it covers (D1). Param-only (L1). The satin sibling of Paint_Gloss: the same white, without the gloss coat. Carries every relevant wear layer at 0 (C1): scratches (overlay 1, damage), dust as a deposit (Phase10), fingerprints, placed by the Edges mask (G damage along borders, B deposit in corners, A handling on open faces). Drafted by /matter-generate for the Kitchen_set look; Storm only, not rigged.
name: Paint_Satin_Clean_Base_s01_v01

sources.note: A whiteboard is a white gloss coating on steel: its colour is taken as the paint's, as on Paint_Gloss. Its roughness 0 is not taken: see the judgement below.

sources.why: Roughness 0.35: satin, between matte (~0.7) and Paint_Gloss's body under its coat (0.3, with a gloss coat on top); no coat, so the sheen is soft and broad. IOR 1.5: an alkyd or acrylic binder.
